exposure: Posterior vaginal fornix approach for cesarean hysterectomy
outcome: Minimizing bleeding from highly vascular placental area
Reducing risk of unintentional urinary bladder injury
cohort: A single patient undergoing cesarean hysterectomy for placenta percreta.
finding: The posterior vaginal fornix approach for cesarean hysterectomy in patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) is an effective technique for minimizing bleeding and reducing the risk of unintentional urinary bladder injury.
